question: Who takes care of plants and flowers in the garden? 🪴
explanation: Great job! A gardener works hard all day to take care of the plants, soil, and beautiful flowers! 🪴
hint: This person uses a spade and waters the plants.

question: Who sells crystal bangles in the street? 💎
explanation: Awesome! A hawker walks down the street selling beautiful things like crystal bangles! 💎
hint: This person calls out loudly to sell things.

question: Who guards the houses in the dark lane at night? 🔦
explanation: Super! The brave watchman stays awake all night to keep everyone safe while they sleep! 🔦
hint: He carries a bright lantern in his hand.

question: What time does the child go to his school? 🏫
explanation: Perfect! The big clock rings dong-dong at ten in the morning when it is time for school! ⏰
hint: It happens right after breakfast.

question: What shiny things does the hawker sell? ✨
explanation: Wonderful! The hawker sells beautiful, shiny crystal bangles that clink together! 💎
hint: They are round and worn on the wrist.

question: Which road does the happy hawker walk on? 🛣️
explanation: Brilliant! The hawker is free to walk on any road he chooses all day long! 🚶
hint: He can go wherever he wants.

question: What time does the child come back from school? 🏠
explanation: Awesome! School finishes in the afternoon, and the child walks back home to play! 🎒
hint: It is a few hours before dinner.

question: What is the gardener doing with the soil? 🕳️
explanation: Great job! The gardener digs the ground to plant beautiful new flowers and trees! 🌱
hint: He uses a spade to move the dirt.

question: What happens to the gardener's clothes while digging? 👕
explanation: Super! Digging in the soil is hard work, so the gardener's clothes get nice and muddy! 🪴
hint: Brown dirt gets on them.

question: Does anyone scold the gardener for getting his clothes dirty? 🗣️
explanation: Perfect! Nobody scolds the gardener because getting dirty is an important part of his fun job! 🌿
hint: He is an adult doing his job.

question: What makes the gardener feel hot while he works outside? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The gardener works very hard outside even when the bright sun is shining down! 🌞
hint: It is the big yellow star in the sky.

question: What does the gardener do when it starts raining? 🌧️
explanation: Wonderful! The amazing gardener keeps taking care of his plants even when he gets wet in the rain! ☔
hint: He does not stop his outdoor job.

question: Who tells the child it is time to go to bed? 🛌
explanation: Great job! When it gets dark outside, his loving mother tells him it is bedtime! 🌙
hint: She is the lady who loves him the most.

question: Where does the watchman walk at night? 🚶
explanation: Super! The watchman bravely walks up and down the dark and lonely lanes to keep them safe! 🔦
hint: The streets with no sunshine.

question: What does the watchman hold in his hand? 🏮
explanation: Brilliant! The watchman swings a bright lantern to help him see in the deep dark night! 💡
hint: It has a light inside it.

question: Does the watchman go to sleep at night? 😴
explanation: Awesome! The watchman stays wide awake all night so that we can sleep peacefully! 👁️
hint: He works when we are dreaming.

question: What does the child want to chase in the dark? 🏃
explanation: Perfect! The child thinks it would be so much fun to swing a lantern and chase shadows! 🔦
hint: They are dark shapes made by light.

question: How many interesting jobs does the child talk about in the poem? 📝
explanation: Great job! The child talks about three wonderful people: the hawker, the gardener, and the watchman! 🌟
hint: Count the hawker, gardener, and watchman.

question: Why does the child want to be a hawker? 🛒
explanation: Super! The child thinks the hawker is lucky because he has the freedom to go anywhere he wants! 🚶
hint: He wants to walk on any road.

question: Why does the child want to be a gardener? 🪴
explanation: Awesome! The child loves the idea of digging in the dirt all day without anyone scolding him! ⛏️
hint: He wants to dig the ground.

question: Why does the child want to be a watchman? 🔦
explanation: Wonderful! The child wishes he could stay awake all night and explore the dark streets! 🌙
hint: He doesn't want to go to bed.

question: What is the beautiful name of this poem? 📖
explanation: Brilliant! The poem is called 'Vocation', which means a special job or type of work! 📝
hint: It starts with the letter V.

question: What does the big clock say at ten in the morning? ⏰
explanation: Great job! The big gong rings 'dong dong' to tell everyone it is time to start the day! 🔔
hint: It makes a loud bell sound.

question: Who is the famous person that wrote this beautiful poem? ✍️
explanation: Super! Rabindranath Tagore was a very famous and wonderful poet who wrote many beautiful stories! 📖
hint: He is a famous Indian poet.

question: Where does the child stand when he sees the hardworking gardener? 🚪

question: Does the gardener mind getting wet in the rain? 🌧️

question: What sound does the hawker make in the morning? 🗣️

question: Who wishes to be a hawker, gardener, and watchman? 👦

question: Why does the child watch these workers every day? 👀

question: Are all the jobs in the poem important? ⭐

explanation: Awesome! Hawkers carry their colorful items in baskets so everyone can clearly see them! 💎
